notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ When Luka uses Basic ATK or Skill, he gains a stack of "Fighting Will" up to 4 stacks. At 2 or more, his Basic ATK is Enhanced and will detonate a Bleed DoT on the enemy target.

✦ His Skill can apply Bleed, and his Ultimate will apply Vulnerability to an enemy target and give 2 stacks of "Fighting Will".

**Noteable Investments**

E6

**Investment Explanation**

✦ His E6 increases his damage output with Bleed.

**Ability Rotation**

[[ability:skill]] spam

Use Enhanced Basic ATK when ready
